frequency_question: How often do structural fiscal council interventions or clarifications on complex financial services clear institutional friction and pass within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items concerning financial sector tax classifications brought before the Indian GST Council since 2017 that faced initial state-level resistance or structural compliance friction; excludes routine procedural tariff adjustments.

cases.name: Racetrack and online gaming 28% GST clarification
Inverted duty structure correction on textiles/footwear (deferred)
Group insurance and reinsurance tax exemption clarifications
Corporate guarantee tax clarity (18% valuation rule)

coverage_note: 5 major contested service/sectoral tax classification disputes named; representative of federal fiscal council behavior under friction.
known_gaps: Does not capture informal subcommittee deadlocks that never reached a formal vote.
skeleton: Named historical contested financial/service tax dispute resolutions by the federal-state council where structural friction had to be negotiated.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 comparable contested structural clarifications successfully resolved despite initial friction.
validity_reason: Council voting structures and federal-state consensus dynamics remain stable unless major constitutional amendments occur.
